errors.text_span: Четири линии представляват данните за различните региони:
errors.evidence: This is a fundamental misinterpretation of the chart. There are five lines, not four, and they represent the years 2016-2020 (as shown in the legend), not the regions. The regions are categories on the X-axis.
The description incorrectly maps lines to regions from the X-axis instead of to years from the legend. It also hallucinates a region named "Област Област" (Province Province).

The description completely fails to mention the X-axis and its six categorical labels: "Общо за страната", "Видинска област", "област Враца", "Ловешка област", "област Монтана", and "Плевенска област".
